purpose: Replace the phonetically ambiguous microsaccade vocabulary with biologically grounded, recallable, tileable names and Gay.jl color chains.

problem.reason: The spoken token is too easy to mishear and too tied to one ocular mechanism when the useful substrate is a retina-scale active sampling and update pattern.

biology_basis.claim: Fixational eye movement includes tremor, drift, and microsaccades; the saccade-like component is rapid and moves the retinal image across many photoreceptor widths.
The functional story includes counteracting fading/adaptation and contributing to active sensing during fixation.
A mechanistic story is synchrony-based retinal ganglion-cell coding: fast image shifts can produce short-timescale synchronous spike volleys at salient contrast edges.
The broader biomimetic framing follows diverse-intelligence and hybrid-embodiment language rather than only genetics-plus-environment lineage tracing.

recommendation.why: It captures small, purposeful-enough image displacement over a receptor mosaic, the information geometry of resampling, and the anti-fade/active-sensing function without using the ambiguous saccade sound.

gay_color_generation.method: Generated with Gay.jl stable_seed, color_at, rgb_hex, and CIEDE2000 colordiff over 900 deterministic candidates.

interpretations.interpretation: Active sampling: the system moves a signal across a receptor mosaic to create the fastest useful update path.
interpretations.biological_pattern: small high-speed image slip over cone/receptor mosaic; contrast edges enter new receptive fields
interpretations.information_geometry: dithered resampling lowers degeneracy and keeps a stationary signal informative

interpretations.interpretation: Anti-fade witness: the same world is held stable by refreshing the substrate underneath it.
interpretations.biological_pattern: photoreceptor and retinal ganglion-cell adaptation is interrupted by fresh local contrast
interpretations.information_geometry: a stable percept is maintained by local renewal rather than by static representation

interpretations.interpretation: Constraint-return coding: the retina answers motion by synchronizing the cells whose receptive fields receive salient edges.
interpretations.biological_pattern: short-timescale retinal ganglion-cell spike volleys after fast contrast-edge displacement
interpretations.information_geometry: meaning appears as coincidence structure: which cells fire together is the code

secondary_candidates.status: good if the intended scope is fixation and high-acuity foveal sampling
good for map-level substrate updates, less vivid as a spoken token
good for the ganglion-cell synchrony interpretation, not broad enough as the canonical name
good for cybernetic/interaction prose, less directly retinal
precise but too technical for the primary recallable

preferred_slug_rules: stable under speech-to-text and code search
collision_notes: retinal_dither collides productively with graphics dither and information geometry
mosaic_refresh collides productively with homeostatic renewal and shared-now witnessing
ganglion_sync collides productively with synchrony, coincidence detection, and coplay constraints

tileability.rule: A tile is valid when the same slug, time coordinate, color seed, and episode fingerprint can be replayed on another substrate without changing the interpretation class.
